title: Liquid crystals and topological vorticity: smoothness of mild solutions
summary: We introduce several new models whose common feature is to take into account effects from topological vorticity. The macroscopic unknown is driven by a dissipative anomalous diffusion (of SQG-type) and is coupled with the orientation of the crystal, moving by the gradient flow of the energy of maps. The main idea of such models is to have a better insight on the vorticity formulation of the Liquid Crystal Flow and to tackle some regularity issues in the associated conserved geometric motions.
